members.name: Dhruva Uppaluri
members.bio: Electrical engineering student at UC Santa Cruz (transferred from Las Positas College) focused on ASIC/SoC design, FPGA development and digital hardware verification. I work in SystemVerilog and Verilog on RTL design, formal verification, synthesis and timing analysis, and I'm building AI-driven FPGA accelerators and neural signal processing hardware. Seeking a Summer 2027 internship.

highlights.title: EEG Brain Signal Controlled Rover
highlights.text: WeaveHacks 4: a hand-built rover driven by EEG brain waves through a multi-agent LLM system with edge inference, using custom transistor motor-control circuits.

highlights.title: Axiom: Neural RLHF
highlights.text: WeaveHacks 4 (24-hour hackathon): three AI agents adapt to a person's focus and engagement, measured with a Muse S EEG headband. I co-created it, proposed the assistive-communication idea, and built the baseline and timing sync between calibration, live EEG readings and scoring.

members.name: Harsh Gupta
members.bio: I’m a computer engineering transfer student at UC Santa Cruz interested in digital hardware, ASIC design, and FPGAs. At hackathons, I’ve worked with teammates on Hanzel, a tool that compares project experience with job requirements, and Friday, a voice-controlled robot arm that draws on paper.

projects.title: Hanzel
projects.summary: A candidate-facing career tool that checks your real project work against a job description and explains how well you fit.
projects.description: Hanzel is the candidate-facing app for our SC-HACK Career Intelligence pipeline. A candidate uploads a resume, picks a target track (hardware, software or product) and links GitHub or website projects. A Depth engine inspects each project's real source and emits cited, evidence-based assessments, since a resume claim alone can't prove implemented work. A Paralegal agent extracts resume signals, two Lawyer agents argue strengths and gaps from the same evidence, and a Judge agent weighs the cases. The match score comes from documented requirement coverage, so the model's narrative can't change it. Hanzel also lists Summer 2027 roles from the SimplifyJobs feed with a preliminary profile screen. Built with Rishi, Harsh and Venya; Dhruva owned Project Depth, the website and integration.

projects.title: Friday: Voice-Controlled Robot Drawing Arm
projects.summary: Say "Friday, draw a smiley face" and a low-cost robot arm draws it, asks how it looked, and adjusts.
projects.description: A four-person hackathon build around the SO-101 robot arm. An ElevenLabs voice agent picks a tool, commands travel over SSH to an AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 station, and the arm turns pen-tip paths into joint commands. We calibrated the pen offset with least squares and inverse kinematics, and estimated pen friction from servo data instead of force sensors. The live voice loop ran end to end once; repeatability is untested.
